metadata.description: Plugins for building LUNA Add Ons with @uaudio/luna-builder-sdk

plugins.name: ua-luna-builder
plugins.description: Build LUNA Add Ons with @uaudio/luna-builder-sdk: scaffold a page, connect to a running LUNA or the in-page WebAssembly engine, read and write transport, tracks, controls, clips and meters, test against Luna.MockEngine, then install the Add On into LUNA's Window menu
